data.location: 790 Waverly Drive, within the Sloan Corners Retail development, Allen (790 S Waverly Dr, Dallas, TX 75208, USA)
data.short_description: A former professional skateboarder is opening a combined coffee shop, lounge and vintage clothing boutique in Allen. The 2,823-square-foot space will host live music, weekend markets and art shows. Founder Michael Rammal confirmed the timeline and described it as his flagship location.

data.status: "is opening in the space long occupied by The Leaky Roof Gastropub"
data.short_description: The Leaky Roof Tavern is taking over the former Leaky Roof Gastropub space in Goose Hollow. State filings list Agron and Roni Pervizi as operators of the new Tavern. No details have been released on what the new concept will look like.

data.status: "shut its doors abruptly this past July"
data.short_description: The 80-year-old Goose Hollow gastropub closed abruptly in July with only a notice taped to the door saying it "will no longer be open." No statement or timeline was given by ownership. The business started as a food cart in the 1940s and moved into the building in 1947.

data.location: 3801 Yosemite Blvd, Suite C, Modesto, CA 95357
data.short_description: Delicias Aly is opening its first brick-and-mortar restaurant in Modesto, serving traditional Mexican food including birria, menudo, quesabirria, chile rellenos, flautas and pozole. Owner Bertha Aguilar already runs a Delicias Aly food truck. This marks her first move from food truck operator to full restaurant ownership.

data.status: "hoping to open the location by mid-October"
data.short_description: Detroit-based Bray's Hamburgers is expanding to a storefront in Lincoln Park, with construction underway. The family-owned 1950s-themed chain serves burgers, coney dogs, sandwiches, fries and onion rings. Owner Agron Duhanaj is also hoping to debut a Shelby Township location at 4365 Auburn Road.

data.status: "preparing to expand with a new location... this winter"
data.short_description: The Orlando-born Colombian coffee and bakery franchise is opening on West Vine Street in Kissimmee, adding to its nine Central Florida locations. The menu includes coffee drinks, cakes, empanadas, arepas, guava and cheese pastries and desserts. The location will take over a building formerly occupied by Hardee's.

data.location: 1285 1st Ave. near E. 69th St., New York, NY 10021
data.short_description: Doughnut Plant plans to open a new shop in Lenox Hill. Founded in 1994 by Mark Isreal, the brand serves yeast-raised round and square donuts, including its original crème brûlée donut, with gluten-free and vegan options. An official opening date has not yet been announced.

data.location: 1952 S John Young Pkwy, Kissimmee, FL 34741
data.status: "will expand its Sunshine-State footprint with a new cafe opening"
data.short_description: PJ's Coffee of New Orleans is opening a new cafe on South John Young Parkway in Kissimmee. The menu features espresso-based hot, cold and iced drinks plus beignets. The location will sit across the street from Medical Villages and Lechonera El Jibarito.

data.status: "hoping to open the location sometime next year"
data.short_description: Afterlife Bar and Grill is a new project coming to a long-vacant former funeral home in Logan Square, introduced by James and Valerie Spyropoulos. No menu has been released, but guests can expect beer on tap, cocktails, burgers and wings. The building is large enough for a full dining area and kitchen, with apartments remaining above.

data.status: "plans to open"; "An official opening date has not yet been announced"
data.short_description: Friedman's Restaurant, known for its gluten-free menu, is expanding to the Upper West Side in an approximately 5,000-square-foot space acquired for $4.135 million. The property also houses Barney Greengrass and Hudson & Charles, which will remain in place. The concept serves American classics including pancakes, waffles and fried chicken.

data.short_description: A new restaurant called Sariel Pica Pollo is planned for a fuel station site on Michigan Avenue in Kissimmee, per plan review paperwork submitted by Sariel Pica Pollo LLC. The concept centers on pica pollo, described as authentic Dominican fried chicken. Owner Rodolfo Vila was not immediately available for comment.

data.location: 9179 Babcock St SE, Palm Bay, FL 32909

data.short_description: Joy Japan Sushi & Hibachi is opening at the Shoppes at Cypress Bay in Palm Bay, which also houses Publix, McDonald's and Jersey Mike's Subs. It appears to be the second location for the restaurant, whose original is at 2215 Nolte Road in St. Cloud. The menu features dozens of sushi rolls, sashimi and tempura.

data.short_description: The Dycore Mobile Luxe food truck is opening a brick-and-mortar grab-and-go café in New Orleans East. Co-owner Cassandra Charlot plans scratch-made parfaits, salads, house-made lemonade and hot entrees, with limited seating and free coffee daily from 6 a.m. to 11 a.m. The venue will also serve as an extension of her non-profit, the Decor Legacy Foundation.

data.status: "set to welcome... later this year"; "An official opening date has not yet been announced"
data.short_description: Tusk, owned by Michael and Joy Grafenstine, will bring elevated American cuisine to Doylestown. The menu features seasonal ingredients, gluten-free and vegetarian options, handcrafted cocktails, martinis and small-batch bourbons. The owners also run Bonnet Lane Family Restaurant in Abington and Roberts Block in Glenside.

data.status: "working to open at 60 E Main Street"
data.short_description: Curry Mantra Indian Cuisine is planned for Apopka according to a submitted plan review document. The menu, already live online, includes Paneer Tikka, Butter Chicken, Vegetable Biryani and Baigan Bharta. The official site does not confirm the address where it will open.

Carnegie Deli is reopening on Seventh Avenue in the former Stage Deli space, once a rival during New York's "pastrami wars." The menu includes pastrami and corned beef sandwiches, Reubens, matzo ball soup, latkes, knishes and a new sandwich called The Carnegie Deli Colossus. The Wall of Fame featuring celebrity photographs will also return.

Swig & Swine BBQ is launching a new concept called Lumpy's Place by Swig & Swine, named in memory of owner Anthony DiBernardo's late son Asher, who died in March 2025 at age 23. The menu will build on Swig & Swine's BBQ with a meat-and-three approach. Further details on the space and menu are not yet available.

data.status: "signs point to something new taking shape... soon"; plan review documents submitted
data.short_description: Plan review documents submitted by Sun and Salt LLC point to a new restaurant called Comptoir in the former Shelf Indulgence space on North Tamiami Trail. The name translates to the English word "counter." What Now reached out to the owner and is awaiting details on the opening and menu.

data.status: "It closed on May 17 of this year"
data.short_description: Shelf Indulgence Used Book Cafe offered secondhand books along with coffee, sandwiches and baked goods. It closed on May 17, with an Instagram post in April announcing the closure details. The space has remained unused since then.

Chef Aarthi Sampath is opening Jam & Jaggery, a speakeasy-style cocktail lounge located downstairs from her restaurant Drāvida in New York City. The cocktail menu blends South Indian diaspora flavors with Spanish cocktail techniques and tropical influences. The lounge will offer cocktails, small bites and a space for private events.

data.location: 4531 W. Hollywood Blvd., Los Angeles, CA 90027
data.status: "The Los Angeles location will open on September 29"
data.short_description: Chipotle is opening a new restaurant on West Hollywood Boulevard in Los Angeles this fall. It will serve the regular menu plus limited-time items, the High Protein Menu and new Pollo Asado and Chili Lime Chips. About 30 jobs are available at the location.

data.status: "the Riverside location will open on October 14"
data.short_description: Chipotle's second new LA-area restaurant this fall will be in Riverside. It will offer the brand's regular and limited-time menu items along with the High Protein Menu. About 30 jobs are available at the location.

data.status: "celebrating the grand opening of its newest location in North Mesa on Thursday, Sept. 24, 2026"
data.short_description: The Arizona-based seafood restaurant is holding a grand opening for its North Mesa location, its 19th in the Valley. The menu includes shrimp, crab, lobster and crawfish with house seasoning blends and seafood boil accompaniments. Opening day festivities include a spicy wing eating competition, live DJ, balloon artist and a spin-to-win table.

Bonanno Concepts has opened Rōmyō, described as Denver's first dedicated itameshi restaurant, on Larimer Square. The concept fuses Japanese and Italian cuisines and grew out of a recurring pop-up hosted at Luca. It seats 80 with a pillared bar, kaiseki section, and patio, led by Executive Chef Johnny Rodriguez.

data.status: "grand opening celebration will take place on Friday, September 25"
data.short_description: Talkin' Tacos is opening its first Tennessee location in Downtown Nashville near Lower Broadway. The grand opening begins at 6 p.m. with free birria tacos, a Jarritos beverage and merchandise for the first 100 guests, plus a live DJ and giveaways. The 3,300-square-foot space seats 85 indoors and 20 outdoors and serves until 2 a.m. daily.

Garbo's is closing its Lamar Boulevard location after three years of operation because its lease is ending and will not be renewed. The family-owned restaurant, run by three sisters, is known for Maine and Connecticut-style lobster rolls. Its North Mopac location at 12709 N Mopac Expy and its food trucks will continue operating.

Senfuku Japanese Restaurant in Downtown San Pedro announced it will close after 45 years as its owners retire. Established in 1974 and operated by Yoshimitsu and Helen Kikuchi since 1982, it became known for sushi along with sashimi, nigiri, teriyaki, tempura and hot-pot dishes. The owners thanked family, staff and customers in a social media post.

data.location: 7220 Louis Pasteur Dr #125, San Antonio, TX 78229
data.short_description: Chef-owner Vinh Hoang announced that Suck It: The Restaurant will permanently close at the end of 2026 after 16 years. The owner cited health issues and economic conditions, and suggested possible future ramen pop-ups at other restaurants. The business was known for ramen, pho and bubble tea.

Panini Kabob Grill is adding a Los Angeles location near the La Brea Tar Pits and LACMA. A company representative said the site is under construction with opening anticipated in early 2027. The brand has other locations planned at 9th & Olive, Valencia, Norwalk, Downey, Eastvale, plus Chandler, Arizona and Las Vegas.

data.status: "planning to expand" / listed among "upcoming planned locations"
data.short_description: The Taco Stand lists Westlake Village among its upcoming planned locations on its website. No address, opening announcement or other details have been released. The San Diego-founded brand operates taquerias across several states and has additional locations in its pipeline.

data.location: 12000 Darden Hill Rd, Driftwood, TX 78619, USA
data.status: "plans to open" / project "in its early phase"
data.short_description: Public filings show a convenience store concept called Darden Hill Market is planned for 12000 Darden Hill Road in Hays County. Co-owner Malek Al Sayyed said the project is early-stage and could be running around January 2028. Plans include gasoline, a liquor store and made-to-go food, with the gas brand not yet finalized.

Bliss Marketplace, a vendor marketplace for vintage furniture, handmade goods and artisan jewelry, is opening a 35,000-square-foot store in the Elk Grove Marketplace center. The site, a former Joann space, will be its largest location and include a dedicated vendor storage area for roughly 250 vendors. Co-owner Sydnei Kelly said customer demand on social media drove the choice of Elk Grove.

The article notes that the Elk Grove space Bliss Marketplace is taking over was long occupied by craft retailer Joann Inc. Joann's nationwide closure occurred last year. No further closure details are given.

Plans include an ARCO AM/PM with eight pumps, a 4,047-square-foot convenience store, retail suite, car wash, diesel island, EV charging and 81 parking stalls. Developer Andy Takhar said construction is targeted for late 2027 or early 2028 with no firm timeline.

Quick Quack Car Wash is preparing to open in Vista, with Newmark Merrill reporting completed exterior finishes, installed equipment, finished concrete and parking lot striping. Landscaping and signage remain. The company's location page lists the site as coming soon, with no official opening date or hours posted.

The location will include a full-service bike shop, snow shop, racket shop with stringing and gripping, and rentals. A multi-story parking garage is planned, with rooftop event space.

data.location: 2200 E Thousand Oaks Blvd Thousand Oaks, CA 91362

The concept houses multiple restaurant brands in one location with made-to-order meals aggregated on a single bill.

Beignets and Brew is preparing to open in Jonesboro after originally hoping to open in the spring. The franchise recently posted that it is recruiting baristas and beignet chefs. It is the second location for franchisees Cody and Kristen McPherson and will share a building with their Jonesboro Potbelly.

A July 23, 2026 City of Irvine document approved a minor modification to the conditional use permit, identifying Philz as tenant in roughly 3,322 square feet. The project includes tenant improvements to the existing drive-through building and minor parking lot changes.

SeaSpice Rooftop Club has opened on the fifth floor of the Jefferson Building near San Antonio's Pearl. The French Riviera-inspired concept, from Gusto Group, combines a seafood restaurant with a nightlife experience.

Café La Lele is opening its first brick-and-mortar location in San Antonio's Beacon Hill neighborhood, in the former Folklores Coffee space. Owners are targeting a potential mid-November opening as renovations continue.

Grays on Main is adding a third-floor VIP experience called The Buffalo Room, featuring a balcony overlooking the live music stage and its own bar. It is expected to open later in 2026.
Burger Republic is opening a new location at Nashville International Airport's Concourse A as part of an $855 million renovation. The concourse expansion is scheduled to be complete in 2028.
Mi Cozumel is expanding to a 6,400-square-foot restaurant with a patio inside Hotel Celare at The District at Clifton Heights. The space was formerly occupied by Cap City Fine Diner and Bar.

Woody's original Jacksonville restaurant, opened in 1980, is expected to close at the end of September as the company relocates the restaurant nearby to the new Southside location.

data.short_description: SUSHISAMBA will open at The Lakefront at Scottsdale, a waterfront redevelopment, as one of three food and beverage tenants ahead of a September 24 groundbreaking. It will be the brand's third U.S. location.

data.location: 933 Fourth Ave, San Diego, CA 92101, USA
data.status: "an exact opening date isn't set yet, estimating"
data.short_description: El Encanto, a Mexican breakfast spot and coffee shop, is relocating from its original 1873 Palm Ave location to downtown San Diego's 4th Avenue. The timeline depends on how quickly upcoming inspections clear.

data.status: "in talks" / "has not yet signed a lease"
data.short_description: V Modern Italian is in talks for a location at The Lakefront at Scottsdale redevelopment. Fast Fine Restaurant Group's CEO confirmed discussions but no signed lease yet.

Texas Roadhouse is opening a new location near Charlotte Premium Outlets in Steele Creek, expected to add about 220 jobs. The restaurant is already listed on the company's website and currently hiring.

data.status: "Grand opening timelines...have not been specified beyond a fall 2026 window"
data.short_description: Black Rock Coffee Bar plans to open a location in Leander as part of a broader Texas expansion including Round Rock, Killeen, and Providence Village. The chain is opening 16 new spots across four states between September and November.

data.location: 250 N A W Grimes Blvd, Round Rock, TX 78664, USA
data.status: "Grand opening timelines...have not been specified beyond a fall 2026 window"
data.short_description: Black Rock Coffee Bar also plans to open a second new Austin-area location in Round Rock along the SH 45 corridor. This is part of the same fall 2026 Texas expansion push.

data.status: "renovations are underway, and the team is hoping to open"
data.short_description: Baba Ash Pizza & Grill is moving into the former DeLuca's pizza spot, which closed in fall 2021 after 60+ years. This marks the family-run business's first expansion beyond its Potter Walsh location.

data.location: 4475 Ingraham St, San Diego, CA 92109, United States
data.status: "ownership change will be effective through September 15"
data.short_description: Sauced Pizzeria in Pacific Beach has new ownership, with Happy Slice Inc. taking over the license from Sauced Pizzeria LLC on September 8. The new owner, Halla Azo, said there are no plans to change the restaurant.

data.location: 4437 SE Cesar Estrada Chavez Blvd, Portland, OR 97202
data.short_description: Cafe Rowan is rebranding to Rowan and launching dinner service for the first time since opening in March 2020. The restaurant already completed its remodel and updated decor, so no closure is planned during the transition.
Little Petals, an offshoot of Petals of a Peony, is opening a new storefront in Raleigh (Memphis), taking over the space previously occupied by Nam King. No opening timeline is presently available.
Oak Steakhouse is preparing to open inside the restored, historic Greenleaf building in downtown Jacksonville. The building will also feature a planned 3,500-square-foot basement speakeasy and bar.

data.location: 5630 N Figueroa St, Highland Park, CA 90042
data.short_description: Double Dutchie has filed permits to open as a bar at 5630 N. Figueroa St., a space previously home to ETA, an oyster bar that has since permanently closed. The permit allows hours from 3 p.m. to 2 a.m. daily and occasional cover charges for live music/DJ performances.

data.status: planned to open; construction expected to start in October and wrap up in February
data.short_description: Golden Chick plans a new location at 1930 N Fry Road in a freestanding building formerly a Pizza Hut, within the Fry Road Crossing Shopping Center. Construction is expected to start in October and finish in February, with an estimated $100,000 project cost.

data.status: owner hopes to have it open
data.short_description: Cocina Mexican Bar & Grill is opening a Lakeland location at 9020 U.S. 64, in a space that previously housed Blossom Asian Cuisine Buffet. The 4,141-square-foot storefront has an occupant load of 99, and owner Marco Puerto hopes to open by October 5.

data.status: construction planned to start mid-February next year, completed by end of May 2027
data.short_description: Sephora is set to open a nearly 5,000-square-foot store at 25581 Tomball Pkwy in The Grand at 249. The interior fit-out project is estimated at $725,000, with construction planned from mid-February to end of May 2027.

data.status: currently undergoing renovations; construction kicked off at the beginning of this month, slated to be completed in February 2027
data.short_description: Hey Beautiful Nail Supplies is rebuilding its Pasadena storefront after a fire caused by a ceiling fan smoked the entire building. The $250,000 remodel of the 3,832-square-foot store is expected to reopen by Spring 2027.

data.status: construction expected to wrap up in June 2027; opening date not yet announced
data.short_description: Kroger is planning a new store along FM Road 741 in Kaufman County, near Crandall, with construction expected to finish in June 2027. An official opening date has not yet been announced.

Golf Rx is expanding its indoor golf simulator concept to a third Massachusetts location at 17 Arlington Street, Suite 1 in Dracut. The facility will feature three indoor golf bays with launch monitor technology and GSPro software, plus beer, wine, and canned mixed drinks.

data.location: 3584 S Hills Ave #120, Fort Worth, TX 76109
data.short_description: Sola Salon Studios plans a flagship location with 52 private suites at 3584 South Hills Avenue, Suite 120, inside the Westcliff Shopping Center in Fort Worth. It will be franchisee Shay Stevenson's ninth Sola location, with pre-leasing underway ahead of the targeted spring 2027 opening.
